description: This PHP class defines a plugin component for the Revive Adserver, specifically handling impression country data logging and aggregation for the openX delivery log plugin. It includes methods for retrieving dependency information, bucket table details, and migration mappings.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLog_OxLogCountry_LogImpressionCountry
classes.description: A plugin class for logging and aggregating impression country data within the openX delivery log plugin for Revive Adserver.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns the dependencies for this plugin component, specifying related data preparation components.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Returns the name of the bucket table used for storing impression data.

methods.name: getBucketTableColumns
methods.description: Returns an array defining the columns and their types in the bucket table.

methods.name: getStatisticsName
methods.description: Returns the name of the statistics table for aggregated data.

methods.name: getStatisticsMigration
methods.description: Provides the mapping configuration for migrating bucket data into the statistics table.
